case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

design.purpose: A raised, drained planting box for one person to grow herbs or flowers, with at least 15 cm of soil depth above the base.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Cut into 36, 36, 18, 18 and 10.8 cm pieces.
Place the medium board flat for cutting.
Cut a 36 cm base, leaving an 83.7 cm offcut.
Place the narrow board flat for cutting.
Cut two 18 cm feet and keep the offcut aside.
Place the 36 cm base flat.
Drill five drainage holes through the base.
Sand all cut edges of the base smooth.
Stand the front side on the front of the base.
Stand the back side on the back of the base.
Fit the left end between the sides at the start.
Fit the right end between the sides at the end.
Place the first foot crosswise under the base start.
Place the second foot crosswise under the base end.
Drive screws through front side into left end.
Drive screws through front side into right end.
Drive screws through back side into left end.
Drive screws through back side into right end.
Drive screws through front side into base edge.
Drive screws through back side into base edge.
Drive screws down through base into first foot.
Drive screws down through base into second foot.
